nodes.description: Private bool flag indicating whether the game (minting/burning rewards) is active; set in startGame and read in _getAmount.
Private address of the Pizzerias liquidity pool on Uniswap; reward is only minted when the transfer sender equals this address.
Private uint nonce incremented on every pseudo-random draw to vary the keccak256 randomness input.
Private uint seed set by the owner in startGame and consumed by _play/_randModulus.
Private uint seed derived in startGame via _randModulus and consumed by _play/_randModulus.
Private uint chance rate initialised to 100 in startGame; declared but not used in the play logic.
onlyOwner external function that initialises chanceRate, liquidityPool, seed1 and seed2 and flips gameStarted to true.
Public overridden ERC20 transfer that routes the amount through _getAmount before calling super.transfer.
Public overridden ERC20 transferFrom that routes the amount through _getAmount before calling super.transferFrom.
Private helper that plays the game (reward mint) and computes a random burn amount when gameStarted is true.
Private helper that mints amount*10 to the recipient when the sender is the liquidity pool and _play returns true.
Private helper returning amount/(rand%(90)+10), i.e. a pseudo-random burn between 1% and 10%.
Public play function that draws two random values in [0,100) and returns true (win, ~1%) when they are equal.
Private pseudo-random generator: keccak256(nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty, msg.sender) % mod; predictable/weak randomness.
Public view returning the gameStarted flag.
Constructor that mints the initial supply of 2500e18 tokens to msg.sender and leaves gameStarted false.
Caller-controlled address; used as mint beneficiary in the constructor and as an entropy component inside _randModulus.
now / block.timestamp; used as an entropy component inside _randModulus, making draws miner-manipulable.
_mint(recipient, amount.mul(10)) inside _sendReward: unlimited inflation of supply gated only by a predictable random draw.
_burn(sender, burnAmount) inside _getAmount: burns a pseudo-randomly determined fraction of a user transfer.
keccak256(nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty, msg.sender) % mod: weak, on-chain observable randomness controlling mint/burn outcomes.

Parameter _seed1 of startGame.

Parameter sender of transferFrom.

Parameter recipient of _getAmount.

Parameter amount of _getAmount.
Parameter amount of _sendReward.
Parameter sender of _sendReward.
Parameter recipient of _sendReward.
Parameter amount of _getRandomBurnedAmount.
Parameter mod (modulus) of _randModulus.
Parameter seed of _randModulus.
Local burnAmount in _getAmount, the pseudo-random quantity passed to _burn.
Local burnrate in _getRandomBurnedAmount, result of _randModulus(90, seed2).
Local val1 in _play, first random draw.
Local val2 in _play, second random draw.
Local rand in _randModulus, the keccak256-derived value modulo mod.

edges.reason: startGame calls _randModulus to derive seed2.
transfer routes the amount through _getAmount before performing the erc20 transfer.
transferFrom routes the amount through _getAmount before performing the erc20 transfer.
_getAmount calls _sendReward to potentially mint a reward.
_getAmount calls _getRandomBurnedAmount to compute the burn quantity.
_getAmount invokes _burn(sender, burnAmount) when burnAmount != 0.
_sendReward calls _play to decide whether the liquidity pool transfer wins.
_sendReward executes _mint(recipient, amount.mul(10)) on a win.
_getRandomBurnedAmount calls _randModulus(90, seed2) to obtain the burn rate.
_play calls _randModulus twice to obtain val1 and val2.
gameStarted gates the whole reward/burn logic inside _getAmount.
startGame writes gameStarted = true, enabling the game logic.
startGame assigns chanceRate = 100.
constructor mints the initial supply to the caller msg.sender.
startGame stores the _liquidityPool parameter into the liquidityPool state variable.
startGame stores the _seed1 parameter into the seed1 state variable.
startGame forwards _seed1 as the seed argument of _randModulus.
_randModulus mixes the nonce state variable into the keccak256 entropy input.
seed1 is used as the seed for the first draw inside _play.
seed2 is used as the seed for the second draw inside _play.
seed1 is consumed by the random generator when _play draws values.
msg.sender is used as an attacker-influencable entropy component in _randModulus.
block.timestamp (now) is used as entropy in the reward/burn lottery, making outcomes miner-manipulable (timestamp dependency).
transfer passes recipient into _getAmount.
transfer passes amount into _getAmount.
transferFrom passes sender into _getAmount.
transferFrom passes recipient into _getAmount.
transferFrom passes amount into _getAmount.
_getAmount forwards recipient to _sendReward.
_getAmount forwards sender to _sendReward (checked against liquidityPool).
_getAmount forwards amount to _sendReward.
the amount parameter of _sendReward feeds the amount.mul(10) mint.
the recipient parameter of _sendReward receives the newly minted reward tokens.
the amount parameter of _getRandomBurnedAmount is divided by the random burn rate.
the mod parameter bounds the pseudo-random output of _randModulus.
the seed parameter is mixed into the keccak256 entropy of _randModulus.
the value returned by _randModulus (90, seed2) is stored in the burnrate local.
the first _randModulus return value is stored in the val1 local of _play.
the second _randModulus return value is stored in the val2 local of _play.
the burnAmount local is the quantity passed to _burn(sender, burnAmount).
